name: TBI Corn Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2000, TBI Corn Ltd is 
a manufacturer and exporter of corn-
based products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) TBICL is an ISO 22000:2018 certified manufacturer and seller of corn products
b) The products are manufactured without chemical additives or preservatives and are GMO-free. 
c) Company sources the highest quality raw maize from Northern Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh, which accounts for 38% of India’s total Maize cultivation.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 101 days to 143 days
